We have so much to offer!

Create an Impact

Coming to Kissterra means that what you do matters. Our technology impacts millions of lives on a daily basis.

Change an Industry

Be part of the digital revolution. Help insurance carriers provide better products to their customers by the smart use of data.

Be Part of a Family

Our company is based on an inclusive culture and we really like each other. Join our team and see what the difference is.

Enjoy the Perks

From free food to free healthcare for you and your family, we do everything we can so you can live care free.

Personal Development

When your workplace becomes a place that makes you happy and fulfilled, you can grow into to the best version of yourself.

Professional Development

Take online courses or fly to global conferences. Get every tool you need to become an industry leading professional.

Social responsibility

Being part of Kissterra is more than just employment; it’s an opportunity to contribute meaningfully to our communities.

We always remember how lucky we are to offer support rather than seek it, and we never take this for granted. It drives us to work hard every day to keep making a difference.
